text:
- **Security & politics:** A Russia-bound ship was reportedly attacked in the Gulf of Finland. Trump’s Iran claims and proposed restrictions on federal contractors’ communications with Congress are drawing attention; international talks on autonomous weapons continue without a firm agreement.

- **Economy & technology:** Headlines report a tech and AI sell-off, with the S&P 500 entering correction territory. EU officials are revisiting a digital tax proposal amid budget negotiations.

- **Public safety & health:** Storms on both coasts and potentially severe Southern California king tides could disrupt Thanksgiving travel. Virginia reported its first measles-associated death of 2026.
